StartEvent.label: Start Event
StartEvent.description: The entry point of a workflow. A new instance is created when this event is triggered.

MessageStartEvent.label: Message Start Event
MessageStartEvent.description: The entry point of a workflow, started by a named message rather than by an unqualified request.

TimerStartEvent.label: Timer Start Event
TimerStartEvent.description: The entry point of a workflow that starts on a schedule rather than because someone asked.

EndEvent.label: End Event
EndEvent.description: The exit point of a workflow branch. The instance completes once every branch has reached an end event.

MessageEndEvent.label: Message End Event
MessageEndEvent.description: The exit point of a workflow branch, sending a named message as it completes.

TerminateEndEvent.label: Terminate End Event
TerminateEndEvent.description: Ends the whole workflow at once, abandoning any other branch still in progress.

IntermediateCatchEvent.label: Intermediate Catch Event
IntermediateCatchEvent.description: A point mid-process where the workflow waits for something to happen before continuing.

MessageIntermediateCatchEvent.label: Message Intermediate Catch Event
MessageIntermediateCatchEvent.description: A point mid-process where the workflow waits for a named message before continuing.

IntermediateThrowEvent.label: Intermediate Throw Event
IntermediateThrowEvent.description: A point mid-process where the workflow announces that something happened, without pausing.

MessageIntermediateThrowEvent.label: Message Intermediate Throw Event
MessageIntermediateThrowEvent.description: A point mid-process where the workflow sends a named message, without pausing.

TimerIntermediateCatchEvent.label: Timer Intermediate Catch Event
TimerIntermediateCatchEvent.description: A point mid-process where the workflow waits for a delay to pass or a date to arrive.

TimerBoundaryEvent.label: Timer Boundary Event
TimerBoundaryEvent.description: A deadline on a task. Fires if the work is not done in time, either cancelling it or raising a reminder alongside it.

MessageBoundaryEvent.label: Message Boundary Event
MessageBoundaryEvent.description: Listens, for as long as a task is open, for a named message such as a withdrawal or a cancellation.

ErrorBoundaryEvent.label: Error Boundary Event
ErrorBoundaryEvent.description: Catches a failure of the task it is attached to, giving the workflow somewhere to go when the work cannot be completed.

UserTask.label: User Task
UserTask.description: Work that a person must carry out. The workflow waits until the task is completed.

ServiceTask.label: Service Task
ServiceTask.description: Work that the platform carries out on its own, without waiting for a person.

ExclusiveGateway.label: Exclusive Gateway
ExclusiveGateway.description: A fork where exactly one outgoing path is taken, the first whose condition holds.

ParallelGateway.label: Parallel Gateway
ParallelGateway.description: A fork where every outgoing path is taken at once, or a join waiting for every incoming path.

InclusiveGateway.label: Inclusive Gateway
InclusiveGateway.description: A fork where every outgoing path whose condition holds is taken.

EventBasedGateway.label: Event Based Gateway
EventBasedGateway.description: A fork decided by whatever happens first rather than by data: the workflow waits, and the first of the events it leads to wins.
